title: Causal Optimizer Interaction Calculus: Hidden Geometric Relaxation and Identifiable Interventions
summary: Optimizer experiments observe responses to algorithmic configurations without uniquely revealing hidden mechanisms. We develop a causal optimizer interaction calculus that separates pathwise realization, Mobius decomposition, and experimental identification. Under a fixed innovation coupling, every finite-horizon innovation-driven optimizer admits a behaviorally minimal pathwise realization.
